name: many-campaigns
about: Four campaigns, figures in the thousands, one with no lead.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 4 campaigns spent $2,580.48 to deliver 161,223 impressions, 2,323 clicks, and 67 leads at a cost per lead of $38.51 and a click rate of 1.4%.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the day's dominant campaign: $1,456.78 spent, 92,400 impressions, 1,310 clicks, 41 leads, and a cost per lead of $35.53 at a 1.4% click rate.
Recent graduates was the strongest performer by click rate at 1.7%, producing 17 leads at $35.89 each from $610.20 in spend across 40,118 impressions.
Dedicated night runs returned 9 leads at $43.22 each — the highest cost per lead of any campaign that produced leads — on $389.00 of spend and 21,005 impressions.
Owner operators generated no leads from $124.50 in spend, 7,700 impressions, and 51 clicks at a 0.7% click rate, so there is no cost per lead for that campaign.
November 2026 has 28 days left and $12,534.06 spent on Meta so far this month.

The mature 2026-09-28 cohort shows the strongest conversion funnel of the settled cohorts: 40 leads, 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 converted (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost after conversion (22.5%); the 2026-10-26 cohort has only 12 leads with movement still in progress, so it is too young to judge.
